name: b10c
cooked: Good catch! Nodes dave and frank are valid-headers, which means they did NOT have the stale block (Foundry) but had the winning block (F2Pool). All other nodes are valid-fork on the Foundry block, which means they had the losing-block (Foundry) first. They then all switched to the winning block once AntPool found 974401. dave and frank were the few nodes that could give it to the network and were then selected as high-bandwidth peers by their peers (their peers send them a sendcmpct(1) message.
